name: Northwind IT Help Desk Chatbot
purpose: Answers Northwind staff questions about IT policies and services from seven policy documents, with cited sources, and (through approved tools) looks up and updates help desk tickets.
users: All Northwind staff through the chat page and POST /ask; the service desk uses it to answer common questions faster
data: Seven fictional IT policy PDFs indexed in Chroma; a fictional help desk database (tickets, assets); questions are not stored, only request metadata
model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 through OpenRouter (fallback openai/gpt-4.1-mini); nomic-embed-text through Ollama for embeddings
notes: practices: none. It only answers from company IT policy documents and declines otherwise, so nothing in Article 5 (no manipulation, no social scoring, no emotion recognition, no biometrics). annex_iii_area: null. It answers IT questions; it does not decide anything about hiring, pay, promotion, credit, education or benefits, so none of the eight Annex III areas fits. safety_component: false. It is not part of a regulated product. narrow_task: false, and not needed because no Annex III area applies. profiles_people: false. It answers the question asked and does not build a profile of the user; questions are not stored, only request metadata. interacts_with_people: true. Staff chat with it directly. generates_content: true. It writes answers in its own words, so Article 50 transparency applies.
